name: Ice mass

source.name: IMBIE
source.citation: IMBIE Team. Mass balance of the Greenland and Antarctic ice sheets, 1992-2020.

describe.what: How much ice an ice sheet holds, compared with 1992.
describe.whyItMatters: Ice lost from the ice sheets raises sea level; 362 Gt is about 1 mm.

notes: Totals per ice sheet, reconciled from 46 satellite surveys. No map at this resolution.
